scenario: The `and` / `or` / `not` expression keyword operators (LGRA.2.11.1) compile in a `where`. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` does not observe the lowering.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    a: Int key
    b: Int mutable

rule r:
    Trig t where (t.a > 0 and t.b > 0) or not (t.a == t.b)
->
    log info "x"
